name: The Assembly Line
tradition: The Motor City Bass Drop now opens every Music Machine home game: the scoreboard runs a four-count down the assembly belt, the Sound System pounds the rail in time, and the final pulse tells the dome the first drive is already on beat.

cue.label: Motor City Bass Drop
cue.pregameLine: The assembly-belt countdown is rolling across the board, and The Assembly Line is waiting on the final pulse.
cue.crowdResponse: The Sound System answers with a HIT! THE! BEAT! chant that lands before the visiting huddle can settle.
